name: Ruakura Berry Shop
seasonZh: 10月下旬起；结束月份 待确认
seasonEn: From late October; closing month Unconfirmed
introZh: 可自采草莓，也有鲜果冰淇淋；请自带容器。
introEn: Pick strawberries and visit the real fruit ice cream shop; bring a container.

name: Whatawhata Berry Farm
fruitZh: 草莓、蓝莓、黑莓、波森莓、覆盆子（按供应）
fruitEn: Strawberries, blueberries, blackberries, boysenberries and raspberries, subject to availability
seasonZh: 待确认；查看农场当日采摘公告
seasonEn: Unconfirmed; check the farm's picking updates
introZh: 农场提供采摘容器，按采摘重量结算。
introEn: The farm supplies picking containers and weighs your berries at checkout.

name: Tauwhare Berry Farm
seasonZh: 采摘月份 待确认；需先确认供应
seasonEn: Picking months Unconfirmed; confirm availability first
introZh: 可自采多种浆果，是否开放须电话或查看农场公告确认。
introEn: Pick several berry varieties when available; phone or check farm updates first.

name: St. Kilda Berry Farm
fruitZh: 草莓（其他可采品种请确认）
introZh: 剑桥 Cambridge 周边草莓采摘点，请自带带走水果的容器。
introEn: A Cambridge berry farm with pick-your-own; bring a take-home container.

name: Blueberry Country — Ōhaupō Orchard
introZh: Ōhaupō 果园提供蓝莓自采，出发前查看当季安排。
introEn: Pick blueberries at the Ōhaupō orchard; check the current season before travelling.

name: Monavale Blueberries
seasonZh: 待确认；官网预告2026年底重开，具体月份待公布
seasonEn: Unconfirmed; reopening toward the end of 2026 announced, exact months pending
introZh: 有机蓝莓园的季节性自采体验，开放消息见官网。
introEn: Seasonal organic blueberry picking; check the orchard's opening announcement.

name: Lavender Backyard Garden
seasonZh: 薰衣草11月下旬–1月底；蓝莓12月下旬–1月初
seasonEn: Lavender: late November–January; blueberries: late December–early January
introZh: 小型家庭花园提供薰衣草和短季蓝莓采摘。
introEn: A family garden offering lavender picking and a short blueberry season.

name: Tomtit Farm
fruitZh: 时令鲜花（含大丽花、百日菊等）
fruitEn: Seasonal flowers, including dahlias and zinnias
seasonEn: December–April; spring sessions October–November, confirm booking
introZh: 可预约自采鲜花，按桶选花并制作花束。
introEn: Book a flower-picking session and gather seasonal blooms by the bucket.

name: Ryburn Gardens
introZh: 自带容器采蓝莓；新季开放日期请先向果园确认。
introEn: Bring your own blueberry container; confirm the new season's opening dates first.
